```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes"))) |>
  add_position_group(collect(select(tbl(con, "roster"), playerId, season, position))) |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
min_picks <- 5
pick_trend <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |>
  group_by(group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(picks = n(), avg_pick = mean(outcome_draft_pick_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(picks >= min_picks)
pooled_pick <- mean(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d[risk$outcome_drafted_d & !is.na(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d)])
lowest_per_year <- pick_trend |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  slice_min(avg_pick, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
n_classes <- nrow(lowest_per_year)
n_qb_lowest <- sum(lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback")
qb_trend <- pick_trend |>
  filter(group == "Quarterback") |>
  mutate(lowest = draft_year %in% lowest_per_year$draft_year[lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback"])

p <- ggplot(pick_trend, aes(draft_year, avg_pick)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pooled_pick, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line_interactive(
    data = filter(pick_trend, group != "Quarterback"),
    aes(group = group, tooltip = group, data_id = group),
    colour = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_line(data = qb_trend, colour = "#D95F02", linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = qb_trend,
    aes(
      shape = lowest,
      tooltip = sprintf("Quarterbacks, %d: pick %.0f on average (%d picks)", draft_year, avg_pick, picks)
    ),
    colour = "#D95F02",
    fill = "#D95F02",
    size = 3.4,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 21, `FALSE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = max(pick_trend$draft_year),
    y = 20,
    label = "Dashed: all picks, average",
    hjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    colour = "grey30",
    label.size = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(qb_trend$draft_year), max(qb_trend$draft_year), by = 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Average overall pick by draft class",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Lower is earlier. Quarterbacks (orange) earliest in %d of %d classes",
      n_qb_lowest,
      n_classes
    ),
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Average pick",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "average-pick-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: every-pick
all_picks <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |>
  mutate(group = reorder(group, outcome_draft_pick_d, median))
p_all <- ggplot(all_picks, aes(outcome_draft_pick_d, group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = group == "Quarterback",
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %s: %d class, round %d, pick %d",
        player, group, draft_year, outcome_draft_round_d, outcome_draft_pick_d
      ),
      data_id = paste(playerId, draft_year)
    ),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.2, width = 0, seed = 1),
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "grey55"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Every drafted season behind the averages",
    subtitle = "Overall pick of each drafted season by position group (box: middle half of picks)",
    x = "Overall pick (lower is earlier)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a point for the player, class and pick."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_all)
```

```{r}
#| label: classes-table
pick_trend |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    classes = n(),
    average = round(mean(avg_pick)),
    earliest = sum(paste(group, draft_year) %in% paste(lowest_per_year$group, lowest_per_year$draft_year)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(average) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Position group", "Classes counted", "Average pick across classes", "Classes with the earliest average"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Average overall pick over each group's draft classes with at least ",
      min_picks,
      " picks, and how many of those classes the group had the earliest average in. The dashed line in the figure is pick ",
      round(pooled_pick),
      ", the average over all drafted seasons."
    )
  )
```
